0.comment: Aramuhukunda: Marana's Avatar and the seals
0.content: Marana's Avatar was imprisoned beneath Old Vanarana by four seals, made by many Aranara with varied Ararakalari in the last war. The first is the Door of Vana, opened with three Inscriptions of Remembrance; later ones are broken by the Traveler and Arama (Stone Pillar Seals among them); the last is Aramuhukunda himself. He opened it for Arama and the Traveler, who then destroyed the Avatar. Marana had corroded the tree meant to grow atop the prison and taken its bodily form.

1.content: Festival Utsava is the Aranara celebration at which the Traveler meets an unnamed Aranara on a tall leaf above Mahavanaranapna, thanking them for letting him see Vanarana's dreamscape again. He explains the true nature of the Bija fruit, accepts the Traveler's flower and says he gave flowers to Nara Varuna at the last festival. Later quests show he was Aramuhukunda.
